fetch_recipe: GET the recorded url exactly (raw Internet Archive id_ form) with no Accept-Encoding request header and no automatic decoding (for example curl -s -o FILE URL, without --compressed), then hash the bytes as received. A client that sends Accept-Encoding can receive an on-the-fly gzip body with different bytes, and a decoding client unpacks bodies that the archive stores compressed.

rows.role_title: President of the African National Congress
rows.printed_range: from the morning of Tuesday 16 December 1997, for five days
rows.text: The Secretary General's introduction to the conference report says delegates assembled on the morning of Tuesday 16 December 1997 for five days, and that the Conference saw the election of a new generation of ANC leaders 'with President Thabo Mbeki at the helm'.

rows.text: The same introduction says the Conference saw the departure of Nelson Mandela as the President of the ANC; the contents list his 'Closing Address by the Outgoing President Nelson Mandela' beside the 'Closing Address by ANC President Thabo Mbeki'.
